content.text:
**Migration Report**

Four submissions, none convincing. Every mean rank correlation was near zero, and no HAC t-statistic exceeded 1.4 in magnitude.

**Failures:** The expanding-window temporal z-score of V03 produced a slightly negative correlation (t about -1.4), opposite to my momentum hypothesis. The V02 versus V04 acceleration spread was essentially zero, with no regime difference. The V05 versus V01 year-over-year spread was also null, and its rank autocorrelation was high (0.73).

**Tentative signal:** The V06 z-score showed a positive correlation in high-T regimes (0.06), contradicting my expected reversal sign. That is weak (t 0.93), and coverage was only 0.52.

**Suggestion:** Try regime-conditioned versions with shorter horizons, and avoid features correlated above 0.4 with the base set.
